Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and open items below.

Summary answers:
- Additional Insured (GL): Can provide a named Additional Insured endorsement naming "Starlite Labs, Inc." (we prefer a named AI rather than blanket AI for downstream risk reasons).
- Primary & Non-Contributory + Waiver of Subrogation on GL: we accept for GL and will instruct carrier to issue endorsement.
- E&O (claims-made): carrier is claims-made — retroactive date request "on or before 2024-01-01" may be possible if prior acts are on the policy or if carrier can endorse back to that date; need broker confirmation.
- Cyber: will include third-party cyber evidence at $5M or provide combined E&O/cyber schedule if carrier treats cyber as part of technology E&O.

Open items / asks for Becky (cc'd):
1) Carrier & AM Best: Please confirm which carrier will be used for each line and supply AM Best rating (we require at least A- for primary carriers).
2) E&O retroactivity: if the current carrier cannot backdate to 2024-01-01, would Starlite accept prior-acts coverage or Extended Reporting Period (ERP) language?
3) Naming: We can add "Starlite Labs, Inc." as AI. We cannot add "and affiliates" as a blanket — if you need affiliates named, please provide explicit entity names.

Timing: Redwood can provide COI + GL AI endorsement pdf within 5 business days after countersignature provided carrier issues endorsement within 48 hours of request. For E&O retroactive adjustments we need broker confirmation and that may take up to 10 business days depending on carrier underwriting.

I've attached a short proposed endorsement snippet our insurance team prefers (proposed_endorsement_sample.pdf). This is a starting point — if Starlite has required mandatory text, please paste it into a reply.

If this matches your expectations, we can finalize the order form redline to lock in the timeline.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Quick read from the broker side — carrier notes below and a couple of options.

Carrier snapshot:
- E&O (TechPro/Chamber Ins Co): claims-made, policy inception 2025-02-01 with retroactive date currently 2025-02-01. Carrier can offer prior acts endorsement to create prior acts coverage back to 2023-01-01 for an additional premium; cannot retroactively backdate to 2022 or earlier.
- GL (Unified General): A- rated; can issue named AI endorsement for "Starlite Labs, Inc." and include Waiver of Subrogation + Primary and Non-Contributory language.
- Cyber (SecureNet): A rated; stand-alone cyber limit available at $5M.

Options for the E&O retroactive date request:
A) If Starlite requires 2024-01-01 specifically, carrier can offer a prior-acts / retroactive endorsement to 2024-01-01 but underwriting needs to review exposures; expect 7–10 business days and an additional premium.
B) If Starlite will accept an attestation that Redwood had continuous E&O coverage with no gaps since 2023, the carrier can provide a letter of prior acts coverage subject to underwriter review (faster).

On naming affiliates: carriers will not accept blanket "and affiliates" automatically — they need explicit entity names for the AI endorsement. If Starlite sends a list, we can add them.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan/Kimberly: confirm whether Starlite can accept named AI (Starlite Labs, Inc.) without affiliates OR provide affiliate list.
- Alex: confirm whether Option A or B for the E&O retroactive requirement works for you.
- Once agreed, I will request endorsements from carriers and upload COI + endorsements to DocuSign evidence portal: https://www.docusign.com/en/starlite-evidence-upload/abcd1234

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call today if helpful.

Best,
